options.name: access_token
options.description: An OAuth2 access token if credential type is accesstoken.

options.name: auth_kind
options.description: The type of credential used.

options.name: description
options.description: An optional description of this resource. Provide this property when you create the resource.

options.name: disk_size_gb
options.description: Size of the image when restored onto a persistent disk (in GB).

options.name: env_type
options.description: Specifies which Ansible environment you're running this module within. This should not be set unless you know what you're doing. This only alters the User Agent string for any API requests.

options.name: family
options.description: The name of the image family to which this image belongs. You can create disks by specifying an image family instead of a specific image name. The image family always returns its latest image that is not deprecated. The name of the image family must comply with RFC1035.

options.name: guest_os_features
options.description: A list of features to enable on the guest operating system. Applicable only for bootable images.

options.name: image_encryption_key
options.description: Encrypts the image using a customer-supplied encryption key. After you encrypt an image with a customer-supplied key, you must provide the same key if you use the image later (e.g. to create a disk from the image) .

options.name: labels
options.description: Labels to apply to this Image.

options.name: licenses
options.description: Any applicable license URI.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the resource; provided by the client when the resource is created. The name must be 1-63 characters long, and comply with RFC1035. Specifically, the name must be 1-63 characters long and match the regular expression `[a-z]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?` which means the first character must be a lowercase letter, and all following characters must be a dash, lowercase letter, or digit, except the last character, which cannot be a dash.

options.name: project
options.description: The Google Cloud Platform project to use.

options.name: raw_disk
options.description: The parameters of the raw disk image.

options.name: scopes
options.description: Array of scopes to be used

options.name: service_account_contents
options.description: The contents of a Service Account JSON file, either in a dictionary or as a JSON string that represents it.

options.name: service_account_email
options.description: An optional service account email address if machineaccount is selected and the user does not wish to use the default email.

options.name: service_account_file
options.description: The path of a Service Account JSON file if serviceaccount is selected as type.

options.name: source_disk
options.description: The source disk to create this image based on. You must provide either this property or the rawDisk.source property but not both to create an image. This field represents a link to a Disk resource in GCP. It can be specified in two ways. First, you can place a dictionary with key 'selfLink' and value of your resource's selfLink Alternatively, you can add `register: name-of-resource` to a gcp_compute_disk task and then set this source_disk field to "{{ name-of-resource }}"

options.name: source_disk_encryption_key
options.description: The customer-supplied encryption key of the source disk. Required if the source disk is protected by a customer-supplied encryption key.

options.name: source_disk_id
options.description: The ID value of the disk used to create this image. This value may be used to determine whether the image was taken from the current or a previous instance of a given disk name.

options.name: source_image
options.description: URL of the source image used to create this image.
